Title: Autospectral on autofluorescence
Format: html
---


```{r}
# Install Bioconductor packages
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(c("flowWorkspace", "FlowSOM"))

# You'll need pak or remotes to install from GitHub.
install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("DrCytometer/AutoSpectral")
```


```{r}
#load autospectral

library(AutoSpectral)
```

```{r}
#Get autospectral parameters and set control directory

asp <- get.autospectral.param(cytometer = "aurora", figures = TRUE)
control.dir <- "D:/CytometerComparison/CytComp_Aurora-data/CytComp_Aurora_Raw/Raw/Reference Group"
```



```{r}
#Create control file and check

#create.control.file(control.dir, asp)

control.file <- "fcs_control_file_1.csv"
check.control.file(control.dir, control.file, asp)
```


```{r}
#clean data and perform singlet gating

spectra <- get.spectra.automated(
  control.dir     = control.dir,
  control.def.file = control.file,
  asp             = asp
)
```
